title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
source: Matrix of SBD (shnid=112408) and AUD (shnid=21916) by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: A matrix mix upgrades an otherwise average three‑star show, highlighted by a rousing Minglewood > Sugaree opener and a solid Scarlet > Fire > Estimated sequence.
ai_review.review: The Hunter matrix blend brings noticeable depth to a thin audience recording, giving the band’s average performance a boost. While the set contains strong moments – especially the opening Minglewood/Sugaree and the second‑set Scarlet/Fire/Estimated flow – there are also sloppy spots like the over‑the‑top Ha Haaas in Estimated and a lackluster Satisfaction oncore. Overall, the mix is good enough to make the show feel more engaging than its three‑star rating suggests.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average (≈2.8/5) but the matrix recording is good (≈4/5); weighted combination yields ~3.2 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Thin audience layer contrasted with a clearer board; Hunter’s mix adds dynamic contrast, gentle crowd fades, extra reverb and bass boost. Overall listenable with some sonic quirks but markedly better than a raw AUD capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 1 opens strong with Minglewood and Sugaree, includes a rare Women Are Smarter closer; Set 2 maintains momentum through Scarlet/Fire/Estimated and flows into The Wheel, though the second half gets a bit sloppy.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s vocals are noted – a slightly silly On The Road Again intro and an over‑the‑top Ha Haaas in Estimated.
